description:
Aggregate statistics for a cohort of companies, per country. Read-only.

        Parameters:
        - dimension (required): "gkl" (UGB size class, AT only), "bundesland", or
          "legal_form" (alias size_gkl -> gkl).
        - value (required): the cohort value (e.g. bundesland "Wien", legal_form "GmbH").
        - country (optional, default "all"): "AT" | "DE" | "all".

        Returns {countries, dimension, value, per_country, notices}. ``bundesland`` and
        ``legal_form`` fan out to every supporting country; ``gkl`` is Austrian-only (no German
        size-class facet) and excludes DE with a notice. Each country's own cohort payload sits
        under ``per_country`` (the registers aggregate different metrics, so they are reported
        side by side, not force-merged). For one company use get_company_details; for a filtered
        list use search_companies.
name: get_cohort_summary
title: Cohort summary (AT + DE)
